new_statements.rule_in_words: Second-hand only: the Wom OPD is reported to say stress is phonemic (contrastive), which implies stress position is not fully predictable from syllable count or weight; no statement of a default position is available. The primary PDF was not opened, so this reading is provisional.
new_statements.domain_note: Nothing said about domain (word vs phrase) or citation forms; the OPD is a 4-page organised-phonology sheet, so the underlying statement is likely one or two sentences at most.
new_statements.identity_note: The OPD and Wikipedia describe Wom [wmo] = Wam (Glottolog womp1235), East Sepik Province; no dialect named. Not to be confused with Wom of Nigeria/Cameroon [wom] (Adamawa) or with Womo [wmx].
